blocks.text: Psalm 150 is wholly devoted to praise, but it does not make praise the Psalter’s only faithful emotional register. Across the collection, individuals and communities also address YHWH with lament, protest, confession, petition, trust, and thanksgiving. This final summons to let everything with breath praise YHWH therefore stands within a fuller range of honest speech to God.

Psalm 150 concludes a collection of 150 psalms arranged in five books, whose earlier book divisions are marked by doxologies after Psalms 41, 72, 89, and 106. Psalms 146–150 form a final crescendo of praise, making this closing call for every breathing creature to praise YHWH the collection’s culminating voice.
